uses.text: 3-Methoxymethcathinone (3-MeOMC), also known as meta-methoxymethcathinone (m-MeOMC), is a designer drug of the substituted cathinone family described as a stimulant. 3-MeOMC first appeared as an illicit drug after 2014.
